insights: Portfolio/gallery-first layout with minimal text - images drive the narrative with titles overlaid or positioned adjacent
Strong tonal contrast strategy: pure black (#0f0e12) backgrounds alternate with white (#fff) and light gray (#f5f5f5) creating dramatic visual rhythm
Viewport-scaled grid system (vw units) ensures consistent proportions across all screen sizes, with 12-column base maintaining modular flexibility
Mobile view transforms multi-column product grids into single-column vertical scroll with rounded corner cards, maintaining generous whitespace and breathing room
